dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「にっいさ〜ん。起きてくださ〜い」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「朝だよ〜」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「緊急回避！」
――ガバッ！

全身のバネを使って起き上がり、すぐに後方に
身をひく。
dialogues.en:
I jumped up using my back muscles, and got ready to defend
myself.
dialogues.text:
I jumped up using my back muscles, and got ready to defend
myself.

dialogues.jp: 壁によりかかり、寝ぼけまなこで辺りを見渡す。
dialogues.en: I leaned on the wall, and looked around.
dialogues.text: I leaned on the wall, and looked around.

dialogues.jp:
カウントがゼロになったはずだが、なにも起こ
らない……。
dialogues.en: Nothing happened as she counted down to zero.
dialogues.text: Nothing happened as she counted down to zero.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「おはよう兄さん♪　外、だんだんと暖かくなっ
　てきてるよ」

階段を下りてクルリと回り、制服姿の音夢が爽
やかに笑う。
dialogues.en:
She's wearing her school uniform. Nemu smiles as she turns
around at the bottom of the stairs.
dialogues.text:
She's wearing her school uniform. Nemu smiles as she turns
around at the bottom of the stairs.

dialogues.jp: 「今、なにをしようとしていた？」
dialogues.en: "What were you about to do just now?"
dialogues.text: "What were you about to do just now?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「数を数えてただけだけど？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「絶対嘘だ……」

音夢の手を見るかぎり、本日は国語辞典も電話
帳も持ってないし、鉄アレイを隠し持っている
雰囲気もない。
dialogues.en:
Nemu didn't have a dictionary, a phone book, or a dumbbell
in her hand today.
dialogues.text:
Nemu didn't have a dictionary, a phone book, or a dumbbell
in her hand today.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「はいはい、こうやっててもなんだから早く制
　服に着替えて」
dialogues.en:
"Okay, okay. Come on, you've got to change into your
uniform."
dialogues.text:
"Okay, okay. Come on, you've got to change into your
uniform."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「え、あれ、なんだ？　どっか行く約束してたっ
　け」
dialogues.en: "Huh? What? Am I supposed to be going somewhere?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? What? Am I supposed to be going somewhere?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうよ……デ・エ・ト♪」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうか」

背伸びをしてまぶたをこすり、音夢が差し出し
てきた制服を受け取る。
dialogues.en: Nemu handed me my uniform as I stretched and rubbed my eyes.
dialogues.text: Nemu handed me my uniform as I stretched and rubbed my eyes.

dialogues.jp: 「……風紀委員の手伝いだっけ？」

せっかくの春休みだと言うのに、目覚まし時計
の時刻はいつもとなんら変わりがない。
dialogues.en:
It's spring break, but the alarm clock shows the same time
as usual.
dialogues.text:
It's spring break, but the alarm clock shows the same time
as usual.

dialogues.jp:
だが、まぁ、勉強するために学園に行くわけで
はないので抵抗は思ったより少ない。
dialogues.en:
But, I feel much better than usual, because I'm not going to
school to study.
dialogues.text:
But, I feel much better than usual, because I'm not going to
school to study.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「違うわよ。お仕事じゃありません」

廊下に出ようとしていた音夢が、楽しそうに振
り返る。
dialogues.en:
Nemu turns around happily as she was about to go out of the
room.
dialogues.text:
Nemu turns around happily as she was about to go out of the
room.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「デート♪」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「分かったよ」

苦笑いを浮かべつつの答えに、音夢も小さく微
笑んで部屋から消えた。
dialogues.en:
Nemu smiled and disappeared as I answered with a wry smile
on my face.
dialogues.text:
Nemu smiled and disappeared as I answered with a wry smile
on my face.

dialogues.jp: 「ふぅ……なんだこれ？」
頬をこする。

なぜだか熱でもあるかのように、頬が赤くなっ
ているのが分かった。
dialogues.en: I knew my cheeks were red as if I had a fever.
dialogues.text: I knew my cheeks were red as if I had a fever.

dialogues.jp: 心臓が激しく脈打つのが分かった……。
dialogues.en: I felt my heart pounding fast......
dialogues.text: I felt my heart pounding fast......

dialogues.jp: ◆緊急回避◆

音夢のカウントダウンに緊急回避をするが、ど
うやらなにもする気はなかったらしい。
dialogues.en:
I avoided the countdown, but Nemu wasn't planning on doing
anything.
dialogues.text:
I avoided the countdown, but Nemu wasn't planning on doing
anything.

dialogues.jp:
そのまま音夢に起こされ、制服を渡される。そ
う言えば、風紀委員の仕事を手伝うことにした
んだっけ。
dialogues.en:
She woke me up, and handed me my school uniform. I remember
I was supposed to help her with the school committee work.
dialogues.text:
She woke me up, and handed me my school uniform. I remember
I was supposed to help her with the school committee work.

dialogues.jp:
音夢の“デ・エ・ト”の言葉に、心臓を激しく
脈打たせながら準備をするのだった。
dialogues.en:
Nemu called it a "date", and that got me worked up as I got
ready.
dialogues.text:
Nemu called it a "date", and that got me worked up as I got
ready.
